name: separator
description: Visually or semantically separates content, horizontal or vertical, built on Radix Separator.

aria: Can be decorative (hidden from the accessibility tree) or expose separator orientation.
consumer: Keep decorative=true unless the separator conveys a meaningful structural boundary.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Whether or not the component is purely decorative. When true, accessibility-related attributes are updated so that that the rendered element is removed from the accessibility tree.
